Data structures for parsing Amazon Linux repository metadata, including the Amazon Linux 2 Extras catalog and standard RPM repository metadata formats.

## Key Components

| Type | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `extrasCatalog` | Parses `extras-catalog.json` from the Amazon Linux 2 Extra Repository, containing topic/package listings with version and deprecation info |
| `repoMd` | Represents RPM `repomd.xml` repository metadata, containing a list of repo data entries |
| `repo` | Represents a single repository data entry with a type attribute and file location |
| `location` | Holds the `href` path to a repository metadata file |

## Usage Example

```go
// Unmarshal Amazon Linux 2 Extras catalog
var catalog extrasCatalog
if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &catalog); err != nil {
    return err
}
for _, topic := range catalog.Topics {
    fmt.Println(topic.N, topic.Versions)
}

// Unmarshal RPM repomd.xml
var md repoMd
if err := xml.Unmarshal(xmlData, &md); err != nil {
    return err
}
for _, r := range md.RepoList {
    fmt.Println(r.Type, r.Location.Href)
}
```

## Notes

- `extrasCatalog` uses JSON tags; `repoMd`, `repo`, and `location` use XML tags
- All types are package-private (unexported), used internally within the `amazon` package
- Source: [`types.go`](https://github.com/flamingo-stack/fleetmdm/blob/main/types.go)
